name: refresh-engine
description: Portable Agent Skills distribution for the refresh-engine Python package.
$comment: This root plugin.json is a portable, spec-agnostic manifest for tools that discover skill collections generically (e.g. `npx skills add`). It is not required by Claude Code (see .claude-plugin/plugin.json) or Codex CLI (see .codex-plugin/plugin.json and skills/refresh-engine/agents/openai.yaml), both of which have their own host-specific manifest conventions documented alongside this file.
